findings.title: Qualified observer SHA is checked only inside old receipts, not against the file launched
findings.trigger: After actual Q/build/SYSTEM evidence is frozen, overwrite or rebuild the same named observer path. The settings still name the old SHA. verify_producer sees an existing file and finds the old path/SHA in the old Q and SYSTEM, so it accepts; the launcher then Popen executes the changed bytes.
findings.confirmed_call_chain: R06 verifies exe.name and is_file then recursively matches stored path/SHA in Q/SYSTEM. prepare_live_refill_add.py explicitly records exe_content_rehashed_here=False. launch_live_refill_add.py only hashes PREPARED and launches native_argv[0] without rehashing that observer.
findings.minimum_fix: Immediately before observer launch, hash only the exact admitted observer path and compare its bytes/SHA with the Q/SYSTEM-bound identity. Rechecking only at initial verify_producer leaves the intervening camera wait open to the same drift. No whole EXE directory scan or guard exception is needed.

findings.title: Census/admission may expire during the later canonical camera wait
findings.trigger: Supply actual fresh admission and complete3+1 samples at line450. Keep the paused native frame unchanged, but start the canonical camera after301 seconds of the allowed600-second wait. The normal2100-second room can still be ample. Launch proceeds with metadata that validate_admission would now reject as older than300 seconds.
findings.confirmed_call_chain: validate_admission checks each sample age and admission age only before full preparation and camera-awaiting. After camera signal, the code checks frame identity/revision then launches. Existing prepare/launcher validation checks scope and argv but has no prepared-age or census-age guard.
findings.minimum_fix: Repeat validate_admission against the pinned same admission immediately after canonical camera completion and immediately before claiming/starting the observer. Expired evidence must stop before launch/Arm; preserve the existing300-second limit and obtain genuinely new evidence in any subsequent authorized attempt.
